coherent_static_test.assumption: ideal instantaneous canonical H/S/SWAP frame action, equal dwell times, static Hamiltonian between frame updates
coherent_static_test.scope: zeroth-order average Hamiltonian only; pulse error and higher Magnus terms excluded
metrics: number of basis terms averaged exactly to zero
mean squared norm of averaged basis term

stochastic_biased_test.invariant_check: global uniform weight-2 ensemble mean must remain unchanged under a code automorphism

correlated_family_test.families: for each of the 9 two-site Pauli types XX,XY,XZ,YX,YY,YZ,ZX,ZY,ZZ, average uniformly over all 28 physical pairs

loss_test.model: independent nonnegative loss probability ell per abstract physical primitive
loss_test.rule: for ell>0, extra physical primitives cannot improve loss survival; virtual frame tracking has zero added loss exposure

stop_rules: coherent averaging is not a hardware claim
global Pauli-ensemble invariance is not an advantage result
a biased-family improvement must be reported together with worsened families
loss benefit cannot be claimed without a compensating source-bound mechanism
